content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Lemon squeezy

Platforms like Lemon Squeezy and Gumroad provide streamlined services for digital product sales, including payment processing and product delivery. However, these services often come with geographical limitations that exclude creators in certain regions. Meanwhile, alternatives like COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack offer a complete digital commerce infrastructure without these restrictions. This stack includes hosting, backend logic, and payment processing, all tailored for creators who demand full ownership and autonomy over their online stores.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Lemon Squeezy and similar platforms typically restrict access based on the user's country, leaving creators in regions like Africa and South Asia stranded. Stripe and PayPal have even stricter policies, with PayPal suspending accounts and freezing funds for up to 180 days without appeal. COREMERCH eliminates these barriers by providing a robust sovereign commerce infrastructure that allows creators to sell globally, bypassing the limitations imposed by conventional payment processors.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

When it comes to payment processing, speed and fees are crucial considerations. Platforms like PayPal and Stripe may offer quick transactions, but they also come with high fees, especially in restricted areas. Moreover, these services can impose additional hidden costs, such as currency conversion fees. In contrast, COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack utilizes NOWPayments, which charges only a 0.5% fee and supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, ensuring lower transaction costs and faster payment confirmations, all while maintaining full access to funds.
Take control of your digital sales with sovereign infrastructure.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

With traditional platforms, creators often find themselves at the mercy of the service provider, lacking true ownership of their digital products and customer data. Lemon Squeezy and Gumroad retain control over the sales process, which can lead to restrictions or account suspensions. COREMERCH's infrastructure, however, shifts that paradigm. Upon deployment, creators own everything — from product delivery to payment processing. This sovereignty not only ensures peace of mind but also affords creators the ability to automate their entire sales process without relying on third-party platforms.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Selecting the right architecture hinges on understanding your unique situation as a digital creator. If you're operating in a restricted country, relying on conventional platforms can lead to frustration and lost revenue. COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack is designed for creators who want to maintain control and autonomy, offering a complete solution that can be deployed quickly and efficiently. By choosing sovereign commerce infrastructure, you position yourself to thrive in the digital marketplace without the chains of outdated systems.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

The direct answer is NOWPayments combined with a sovereign commerce stack. NOWPayments is a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 coins, charges 0.5% per transaction, and sends a webhook to your backend the moment payment confirms on-chain. Your backend — a Cloudflare Worker in Stack 02, a Google Apps Script Web App in Stack 01 — receives the webhook, verifies the transaction hash on the blockchain, logs the order, generates a receipt, and sends the delivery email automatically. There is no platform that can suspend your access, no compliance team that can flag your account, no payout schedule that delays your revenue, and no company that can change the rules on you tomorrow.
Say goodbye to account freezes and payment restrictions.

Creators researching Stripe and PayPal alternatives consistently arrive at the same conclusion: the problem is not finding a single substitute payment processor — it is rebuilding the entire commerce stack on infrastructure that does not inherit the restrictions of the conventional financial system. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is the complete deployment: Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase plus NOWPayments, deployed in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, 30-day support included. If you want to build it yourself, the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents both Stack 01 and Stack 02 in complete detail with full source code. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Accept that no workaround inside conventional payment infrastructure is durable — platforms actively close gaps as they discover them. Create a NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as your starting point — these cover the widest range of buyers in restricted markets. Choose your stack: Stack 01 for a self-deployed free setup using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, Stack 02 for the Edge Stack deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. Configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint URL in your IPN settings pointing to your backend. Upload your product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the full pipeline: webhook received, transaction verified on-chain, order logged, delivery email sent, download link working. Share your store URL only after the mainnet test passes cleanly.
